_comment: Merged into ~/.claude/settings.json by scripts/install.sh, which replaces CCB_PY with the absolute path of scripts/ccb.py. Hooks load at Claude Code session start, so restart sessions after changes. ccb.py exits immediately unless CCB_TASK is set (ccb start sets it), so manual `claude` sessions are untouched. PermissionRequest is the blocking interception point: it publishes the question / permission and waits up to config.answer_timeout (3300 s) for `ccb answer`; its `timeout` must stay above that.
